_why: Files in OTHER repos that this workstream ported behaviour FROM. The port is only as current as the source, and nothing tells us when the source moves — the sha is the notification. Warn-only by design: a change here is a PROMPT TO GO LOOK, not a verdict. The one entry that BLOCKS is noShow.js, and it blocks in its own check (noshow-freshness.js) because a 3-way parity test is bound to it.
_howToUpdate: Read the upstream diff FIRST. If the behaviour moved, update the port and the doc, then re-record. If it was cosmetic, re-record and say so in the note. Never re-record to silence it.

watch.why: The six report reasons and both copy paragraphs are a VERBATIM port of the live Selectpopup list, including 'Violates Age-Restricted Policies', which the worker app's list does not have. If upstream adds, removes or rewords a reason, the web port is silently wrong and there is no test that would notice.

This file is the CANON cited for auto-start: 'the first Gopher to accept your request is off to the races' / 'requires little to no engagement on your part'. The bridge auto-hires AND auto-starts on that wording. If the wording changes, the ruling it rests on has changed.

This is the reference for money entry: type=number + parseFloat, cost_of_goods in cents. It is what proved the prototype's digit-stripping was a defect rather than a choice. If it changes, the money fix's justification changes with it.
